fields.summary: TC-767-01: Final COA Audit Message Header Prevents Re-Processing of Audited Trip in Stream App

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-767

Precondition: A trip has been audited and the final COA message has been published with a special header identifying it as a final audit event. The stream app must detect this header and skip re-processing the event to prevent duplicate COA Step Function invocations.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Complete an audit for a trip so that the final COA message is published to the pairing and assignment Kafka topics with the designated final audit header
Final COA message published with header: isFinalCOAAuditMessage=true (or equivalent header field) on both pairing and assignment events
Final COA audit message is published to Kafka topics with the correct header present
Verify the stream app consumes the message from the Kafka topic and reads the final audit header
Stream app log / CloudWatch after consuming the final COA audit message
Stream app reads the message and detects the final audit header flag
Verify the stream app skips sending the event to the aggregated topic and does NOT invoke the COA Step Function for this message
Stream app processing log for the final COA audit message
Stream app does not publish the event to the aggregated topic - COA Step Function is NOT invoked again for this already-audited trip
Verify that a non-final (regular) pairing or assignment event for the same trip still gets processed normally by the stream app
Regular pairing event (no final audit header) published for same trip after audit
Regular event without the final audit header is processed normally and forwarded to the aggregated topic
Confirm no duplicate COA records or duplicate Step Function executions are created for the audited trip after the final message is published
DynamoDB coatable and Step Function execution history after final COA audit message processing
No duplicate COA record entries and no additional Step Function executions triggered for the audited trip
